{"hypotheses": [
  {"name": "H1", 
   "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth (AssetGrowth) and high intangible returns (IntanEP) demonstrate strong future performance when market volatility is low (VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN), due to increased investor confidence and reduced risk aversion.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "IntanEP"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},

  {"name": "H2", 
   "mechanism": "Firms with high revenue growth (MeanRankRevGrowth) and low market leverage (Leverage) tend to outperform during economic expansion (TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE) due to their financial stability and growth potential.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "MeanRankRevGrowth"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": null},

  {"name": "H3", 
   "mechanism": "Firms with low bid-ask spread (BidAskSpread) and high book-to-market ratio (BM) perform well when market is trending down (MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN), as they are undervalued yet liquid.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -1, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}, {"weight": 1, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": false}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

  {"name": "H4", 
   "mechanism": "Firms with high institutional ownership (DelBreadth) and high earnings surprises (EarningsSurprise) tend to perform better in positive market conditions (MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP) due to information efficiency and positive sentiment.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1, "primitive": "DelBreadth"}, {"weight": 1, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},

  {"name": "H5", 
   "mechanism": "Companies with high earnings consistency (EarningsConsistency) and low idiosyncratic risk (IdioVolAHT) tend to perform well in high market volatility (VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN) due to their stability.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -1, "primitive": "IdioVolAHT"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60},

  {"name": "H6", 
   "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth (AssetGrowth) and low leverage (Leverage) tend to perform well during economic expansions (TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE) due to their growth potential and financial stability.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},

  {"name": "H7", 
   "mechanism": "Firms with high revenue surprise (RevenueSurprise) and low price levels (Price) outperform in down-trending market (MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN) due to their value proposition and positive earnings news.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "RevenueSurprise"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Price"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": false}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

  {"name": "H8", 
   "mechanism": "Companies with high advertising expenses (AdExp) and high sales growth (GrSaleToGrInv) outperform during economic expansions (TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE) due to their investment in brand promotion and growing sales.", 
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "AdExp"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36}
]}
